QuestInfo.name: Shati's Worries
QuestInfo.0: Shati lived in the most luxurious house of the city still seemed worried. Find out why.
QuestInfo.1: Shati feels bad that people are put in turmoil by her greedy father, Tigun. Shati says she will return items to the people even if she has to steal them if she is not able to convince her father to do it on his own. Shati wants you to go to the #bSand Bandits#k and deliver a message, requesting that they steal her father's wealth.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta delivered Shati's message to the Sand Bandits, but Jano refused to taint the bandit name over some petty theft.

0.0: Tigun tricked you too? I'm so sorry... He's my daddy. He's not a bad person, he's just really greedy...
0.1: I can't let him keep acting like this when those poop-headed royals are making everybody suffer! Will you help me, please?

yes.0: Hmph! If I can't convince daddy to stop being greedy, I'll just have to steal from him! But I can't do it myself or he'll know. Ask the Sand Bandits to steal from daddy and give all his money to the poor. I heard there's a #bSand Bandits' Hideout#k in town somewhere.

no.0: His endless greed will only make others suffer more...

npc.0: My daddy's greed is making everyone suffer! Please tell the #bSand Bandits#k to steal everything!
